layers.name: Bootstrap and Providers
layers.description: React mount, top-level providers, route orchestration, runtime theme sync, analytics, speed insights, and global app concerns.

layers.name: Routing and URL Model
layers.description: Locale-aware URL tables, React Router pages, path matching, fallback routing, static HTML entry shells, and navigation path helpers.

layers.name: Dynamic Page Factories
layers.description: Reusable page templates for service, vertical, resource, and legal pages, including structured data, page sections, breadcrumbs, and related links.

layers.name: Homepage Composition
layers.description: The home page sections, social proof, service cards, portfolio entrypoints, FAQ, testimonials, contact CTA, navbar, and footer composition.

layers.name: Content Data Model
layers.description: Typed data modules that define service, vertical, resource, legal, translation, portfolio, and generated catalog content consumed by page factories.

layers.name: Media and Video System
layers.description: Video playback primitives, R2/CDN URL builders, poster/LQIP data, generated clip catalogs, transcript sources, and video processing scripts.

layers.name: Interaction and Performance Utilities
layers.description: Custom hooks, contact dock event bus, hashless section scrolling, mobile detection, deferred mounting, referral attribution, and performance diagnostics.

layers.name: Motion and Design System
layers.description: Framer Motion helpers, text reveal components, shadcn/Radix primitives, Tailwind configuration, CSS tokens, and layout utility styles.

layers.name: SEO, Static Assets, and Deployment
layers.description: SEO head mutation, robots, sitemaps, LLM text surfaces, Vercel config, Vite build entries, and scripts that enrich static entry pages.

layers.name: Project Config and Documentation
layers.description: Package metadata, TypeScript and lint configuration, environment examples, project reports, and supporting documentation.

tour.title: Application Bootstrap
tour.description: Start at the DOM mount, providers, and global app shell to understand what wraps every route.

tour.title: Locale and Route Model
tour.description: Understand bilingual URL tables before reading any route template, because templates receive route ids and locale from this map.

tour.title: Homepage Composition
tour.description: Read the home page as a performance-aware composition of hero, deferred sections, media, and footer.

tour.title: Content-Driven Route Factories
tour.description: Inspect the service, vertical, resource, and legal page factories alongside the data modules that feed them.

tour.title: Media Runtime and Catalog Generation
tour.description: Follow clip metadata from R2 URL builders and generated catalogs into lazy previews, hero tiles, portfolio cards, and theater playback.

tour.title: SEO, Static Shells, and Deployment
tour.description: Finish with the head manager, static route shells, Vite multi-entry build, public crawler files, and Vercel deployment policy.
